In the figure shown above, determine the measure of $∠GOH$ given that $m∠BOD={120}^{∘}.$
question.worked_solution:
From the diagram, $∠AOC$ and $∠EOG$ are vertical angles. Since vertical angles are congruent, we have

$$
m∠AOC=m∠EOG={90}^{∘}.
$$

On the other hand, since $∠AOC$ is a right angle, the angle addition postulate gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠AOB+m∠BOC & =m∠AOC \\ {30}^{∘}+m∠BOC & ={90}^{∘} \\ m∠BOC & ={60}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, given that $m∠BOD={120}^{∘}$, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠BOC+m∠COD & =m∠BOD \\ {60}^{∘}+m∠COD & ={120}^{∘} \\ m∠COD & ={60}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, $∠COD$ and $∠GOH$ are vertical angles. Therefore, 

$$
m∠GOH=m∠COD={60}^{∘}.
$$
